title: Aphrodisiac 2
description:
Delve deep into the tentacle-filled Aphrodisiac Den!Aphrodisiac 2 is a 2D adult adventure platformer set in the wild Tentacle Den. Explore ecosystems filled with feral tentacles and pacify them through seduction.

Hunt for hidden treasures and powers, customize your abilities and create your own unique specialization! With more than 50 unique jewels, 7 spells and special attacks, there's all kinds of cool interactions to be discovered.

This game Includes optional sexually-explicit animations and text narrations, accessible through deliberate interaction. This content can be disabled from the in-game settings.

The magical powers of LustYou control Flora, a sorceress exploring a tentacle-filled Den. As you explore suggestive environments, and pacify the tentacles which inhabit them, you will find new powers in the form of Jewels. Jewels can be switched at any time, allowing you full control over the powers that Flora can access.

Pacifying the DenThe Den is a world of its own, made up of many different ecosystems, and each is filled with unique species of tentacles! In this exotic place, seduction works better than violence, but it will take some skill to survive their initial hostility! This game will present many challenges, and it's up to you to find the best way to face them. Will you select the best combination of jewels for the job? Grind for levels to overpower the enemy? Or learn their patterns and weave through them?

Exploring desire, sexuality, and intimacy... in a different wayPacify creatures, learn more about them, and win over their affection. With Consent as a foundational pillar, you can be sure that any and all interactions are fully appreciated by both parties.

(on a serious note)

As pornography takes over the minds of so many, this game tries a different approach to give those who need and want it, help, while not taking away the draw of such content to those who responsibly consume it. Everything from gameplay to art is designed with this in mind: Violence has no place in intimacy, and real intimacy is a long journey.

Enjoy =D
description_short: A 2D Erotic Metroidvania about pacifying the Tentacle Den through seduction! 50+ unique upgrades to find and 8 Ecosystems filled with creatures to tame. An 18+ game where winning gets you what you want ;)
